simple.meaning: תַּנְחֻמֶת (Tanchumeth) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 2 Kings, Jeremiah, beginning at 2 Kings 25:23. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תַּנְחֻמֶת (H8576) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows תַּנְחֻמֶת through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.full: H8576. Tanchumeth תַּנְחֻ֫מֶת proper name, masculine (? Lag BN 126 f. thinks feminine ) parent of Seraiah, a Hebrew captain, after fall of Jerusalem Jer 40:8 = 2Kin 25:23 ( Lag l.c. conjecture תסחמת , Egyptian name). נַחְנוּ see אֲנַחְנוּ b above
